summary: Design complaint intake, escalation, root-cause and governance workflows. Explore the five-day complaints management course and plan your training.
lede: Complaints management training helps operations and service-quality teams design consistent processes for receiving, assessing and resolving complaints. Participants practise case classification and risk-based escalation, use Pareto analysis and the 5 Whys to investigate recurring issues, and track corrective actions and complaint trends for governance reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own complaint workflows, investigate cases, oversee redress or report service-quality risks. It suits people who need to connect customer-facing resolution with root-cause evidence and governance controls.
modules: Complaint KPI Dashboard and Improvement Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with customer operations, complaint handling or service-quality processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
